facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2026-0093 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 1 June 2026 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including INC-2015-007 and INC-2015-012. The change assurance record covers 5 clauses across 5 controlled documents. The intent is to restate an existing duty without altering what it requires. The record reached the state dispositioned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2019-0221, PRO-MEC-021, PTW-STD-002, STD-ISO-006 and STD-PTW-001.
